content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Arvada

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires specific education and project-management experience before you apply. Review PMI's eligibility criteria—education level, years of work experience, and hours leading projects—to ensure you meet the baseline. Granite PM Academy can clarify whether your background qualifies.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Bootcamp. Our structured course covers all PMBOK® Guide domains and PMI exam content. Attend sessions on your schedule; you'll earn the 35 required contact hours and receive your education certificate upon completion.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Once you've finished the bootcamp, apply directly to PMI through their portal. Provide your education certificate, project experience details, and required fees. PMI reviews applications to confirm eligibility before approving your exam attempt.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Pass the PMP Exam
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy provides exam-prep support, including practice questions and focused review sessions. Study the materials, take mock exams, and refine your test-taking strategy. You'll sit for the computer-based exam at a Pearson VUE testing center when ready.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: PMP certification lasts three years. During each renewal cycle, earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) through approved activities—training, volunteer work, or published contributions. Renew your credential by submitting PDU documentation and the renewal fee to PMI.
